title: Optional runner field on steps: validator, ledger column, index column
goal: A step can record who runs it, and the coordinator index carries it
acceptance: work-items accepts an optional runner (lowercase kebab, up to 40 characters) and refuses other values
the generated ledger shows a Runner column only in a record where some open step has a runner
backlog-index writes steps.runner and adds the column to an index file written before it
parallel-work and steps pages describe the field as data, never a requirement; minor release with upgrade notes
privacy: Tool and documentation text only; fixtures are invented; no personal data.
escalation: Making the field required, or a rule to fill it, goes to the owner (process freeze)

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 at agent speed. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-27; verification is the merged PR's green CI and the tag.
